components.name: Volume choice
components.description: A group of options with an ink-colored selection and light text.
components.css: .ds-volume{display:flex;gap:6px;}.ds-volume button{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cdd5ca);border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#263d33);padding:10px 16px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;}.ds-volume span{font-weight:400;}.ds-volume button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink,#263d33);color:var(--bg,#fbfaf5);border-color:var(--ink,#263d33);}.ds-volume button:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]){background:var(--soft,#e5eadd);}.ds-volume button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#263d33);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Phone tea selection
components.description: Six buttons in a compact three-column grid.
components.css: .ds-picker{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;max-width:460px;}.ds-picker button{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;min-width:0;min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cdd5ca);border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#263d33);padding:10px 4px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;}.ds-picker button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink,#263d33);color:var(--bg,#fbfaf5);border-color:var(--ink,#263d33);}.ds-picker button:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]){background:var(--soft,#e5eadd);}.ds-picker button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#263d33);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Custom volume
components.description: A numeric field with a readable label and error state.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Objętość w ml <input type="number" min="1" max="10000" step="1" value="350"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--ink,#263d33);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;}.ds-field input{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif;width:112px;min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--muted,#58675c);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--surface,#fbfaf5);color:var(--ink,#263d33);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;accent-color:var(--accent,#59784f);caret-color:var(--accent,#59784f);}.ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--error,#8f392b);}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#263d33);outline-offset:4px;}

components.css: .ds-table{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;text-align:left;color:var(--ink,#263d33);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-table tr{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#cdd5ca);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#cdd5ca);transition:background-color 160ms ease-out;}.ds-table tr:hover{background:var(--soft,#e5eadd);}.ds-table tr.ds-selected{background:var(--soft,#e5eadd);}.ds-table th{padding:0 0 0 12px;font-weight:600;}.ds-table td{padding:14px 12px;font-size:24px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-table button{font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:48px;border:0;border-radius:0;padding:14px 4px 14px 0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#263d33);font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;text-align:left;}.ds-table button[aria-pressed="true"]::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#59784f);}.ds-unit{font-size:.65em;font-weight:400;margin-left:4px;color:var(--muted,#58675c);}.ds-table button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#263d33);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-table tr{transition:none;}}

components.description: A compact ink-colored wordmark with a green dot, linking to the home page.
components.html: lazy-tea.

narrative.overview:
A light dashboard on a paper background, with green ink and a calm green accent. The direction matches the dashboard selected by the user: large, readable parameters, a lighter timer and the lazy-tea. wordmark with a green dot.

Flat dividers and compact typography make brewing data easy to scan. The layout adjusts its density for phones and landscape tablets while preserving comfortable controls, clear selection and a clear timer state.
keyCharacteristics: Paper background, dark green ink and a green accent.
Locally hosted Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and tabular numerals.
Flat dividers, outlined choices and gently rounded controls.
A lightweight timer and a stronger wordmark with a green dot.

rules.name: The Clear selection Rule
rules.body: Selected options have an ink fill and light text; the selected row has a sage background and a green dot.

rules.name: The Calm numbers Rule
rules.body: Parameters and the timer use tabular numerals; units and labels remain smaller than their values.

rules.name: The Flat surfaces Rule
rules.body: Separate groups with a rule, spacing or an existing sage surface tone.

dos: Do use the paper background, green ink and locally hosted Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.
Do preserve a lightweight timer, stronger values and smaller units.
Do preserve visible focus and touch targets of at least 48 px.
Do check complete content on phones and short landscape tablets.
donts: Don't restore the replaced dark palette with a gold accent.
Don't split the six-tea table into cards in the landscape dashboard.
Don't add decorative shadows, entrance animations or animation on every second.
